title.en: Unit 11: The Seeker of Truth, Praise and Blame, and the Rights of Neighbours
title.ur: Unit 11: Haqeeqat ki Talash, Madh o Zamm aur Padosiyon ke Huqooq

title.en: Intensive reading: The seeker of truth
title.ur: Gehri qirat: Haqeeqat ki talash karne wala

intro.en: In this lesson we read how Salman al-Farisi searched for the truth until he met the Prophet ﷺ and accepted Islam. Read slowly, sentence by sentence, and notice the places he travelled to.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum parhenge ke Salman al-Farisi (radiyallahu anhu) ne haqeeqat ki talash kaise ki, yahan tak ke woh Nabi ﷺ se mile aur Islam qubool kiya. Aahista aahista, jumla ba jumla parhein aur un shehron par dhyan dein jahan woh gaye.
intro.ar: نَقْرَأُ في هذا الدَّرْسِ كَيْفَ بَحَثَ سَلْمانُ الفارِسِيُّ عَنِ الحَقيقَةِ حَتّى لَقِيَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ وَأَسْلَمَ. اقْرَأْ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً وَانْتَبِهْ إِلى الأَماكِنِ الَّتي سافَرَ إِلَيْها.

dialogue.ar: مِنْ أَشْهَرِ قِصَصِ الباحِثينَ عَنِ الحَقيقَةِ قِصَّةُ سَلْمانَ الفارِسِيِّ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ.
dialogue.tr: min ashhari qiṣaṣi l-bāḥithīna ʿani l-ḥaqīqati qiṣṣatu salmāna l-fārisiyyi raḍiya Allāh ʿanh.
dialogue.en: One of the most famous stories of those who searched for the truth is that of Salman al-Farisi, may Allah be pleased with him.
dialogue.ur: Haqeeqat ki talash karne walon ki mashhoor tareen kahaniyon mein se ek Salman al-Farisi (razi Allahu anhu) ki kahani hai.

dialogue.ar: وُلِدَ سَلْمانُ في بِلادِ فارِسَ، وَكانَ أَبوهُ مَجوسِيّاً قاطِناً في أَصْبَهانَ.
dialogue.tr: wulida salmānu fī bilādi fāris, wakāna abūhu majūsiyyan qāṭinan fī aṣbahān.
dialogue.en: Salman was born in Persia, and his father was a Magian living in Isfahan.
dialogue.ur: Salman Faris mein paida hue aur un ke walid Isfahan mein rehne wale majoosi the.

dialogue.ar: أَحَبَّهُ أَبوهُ حُبّاً شَديداً، فَكانَ يَطْلُبُ مِنْهُ أَنْ يَبْقى في البَيْتِ لِيَخْدُمَ النّارَ الَّتي لا تَنْطَفِئُ.
dialogue.tr: aḥabbahu abūhu ḥubban shadīdan, fakāna yaṭlubu minhu an yabqā fī l-bayti liyakhduma n-nāra allatī lā tanṭafiʾ.
dialogue.en: His father loved him greatly, so he kept him at home to serve the fire that was never put out.
dialogue.ur: Un ke walid un se bohat mohabbat karte the, is liye unhein ghar mein rakhte taake woh us aag ki khidmat karen jo kabhi bujhti nahin thi.

dialogue.ar: وَذاتَ يَوْمٍ مَرَّ بِكَنيسَةٍ فَسَمِعَ أَهْلَها يُصَلّونَ، فَأَعْجَبَهُ ما رَأى.
dialogue.tr: wadhāta yawmin marra bikanīsatin fasamiʿa ahlahā yuṣallūn, faʾaʿjabahu mā raʾā.
dialogue.en: One day he passed by a church, heard its people praying, and liked what he saw.
dialogue.ur: Ek din woh ek girjaghar ke paas se guzre, wahan ke logon ko ibadat karte suna aur jo dekha woh unhein pasand aaya.

dialogue.ar: فَسَأَلَ: أَيْنَ أَصْلُ هَذا الدّينِ؟ فَقيلَ لَهُ: في بِلادِ الشّامِ.
dialogue.tr: fasaʾal: ayna aṣlu hādhā d-dīn? faqīla lah: fī bilādi sh-shām.
dialogue.en: He asked: Where does this religion come from? He was told: From the land of Syria.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne poocha: Is deen ki asl kahan hai? Jawab mila: Mulk-e-Shaam mein.

dialogue.ar: فَتَرَكَ بَيْتَهُ وَسافَرَ إِلى الشّامِ، وَتَعَلَّمَ عِنْدَ أُسْقُفِّ الكَنيسَةِ هُناكَ.
dialogue.tr: fataraka baytahu wasāfara ilā sh-shām, wataʿallama ʿinda usquffi l-kanīsati hunāk.
dialogue.en: So he left his home, travelled to Syria and studied with the bishop of the church there.
dialogue.ur: Chunancha unhon ne ghar chhoda, Shaam gaye aur wahan girjaghar ke bishop ke paas seekha.

dialogue.ar: لَكِنَّ هَذا الأُسْقُفَّ لَمْ يَكُنْ صادِقاً، فَقَدْ جَمَعَ المالَ لِنَفْسِهِ وَلَمْ يُعْطِ الفُقَراءَ شَيْئاً.
dialogue.tr: lākin hādhā l-ʾusquffa lam yakun ṣādiqan, faqad jamaʿa l-māla linafsihi walam yuʿṭi l-fuqarāʾa shayʾan.
dialogue.en: But this bishop was not honest; he collected money for himself and gave the poor nothing.
dialogue.ur: Lekin yeh bishop sacha nahin tha; us ne maal apne liye jama kiya aur gareebon ko kuch na diya.

dialogue.ar: فَلَمّا ماتَ جاءَ أُسْقُفٌّ آخَرُ، وَكانَ زاهِداً عابِداً، فَأَحَبَّهُ سَلْمانُ وَلازَمَهُ.
dialogue.tr: falammā māta jāʾa usquffun ʾākhar, wakāna zāhidan ʿābidan, faʾaḥabbahu salmānu walāzamah.
dialogue.en: When he died, another bishop came, a humble worshipper, and Salman loved him and stayed close to him.
dialogue.ur: Jab woh mar gaya to doosra bishop aaya jo zahid aur ibadat guzaar tha; Salman ne use chaha aur us ke saath rahe.

dialogue.ar: وَلَمّا اقْتَرَبَ أَجَلُهُ وَحَضَرَتْهُ الوَفاةُ سَأَلَهُ سَلْمانُ: مَنْ تُوصيني أَنْ أَتَّبِعَ بَعْدَكَ؟
dialogue.tr: walammā qtaraba ajaluhu waḥaḍarathu l-wafātu saʾalahu salmān: man tūṣīnī an attabiʿa baʿdak?
dialogue.en: When death came to him, Salman said to him: Whom do you advise me to follow after you?
dialogue.ur: Jab us ki maut ka waqt aaya to Salman ne kaha: Aap ke baad aap mujhe kis ke paas jaane ki wasiyat karte hain?

dialogue.ar: فَدَلَّهُ عَلى رَجُلٍ صالِحٍ في مَدينَةِ المَوْصِلِ، فَرَحَلَ إِلَيْهِ وَعاشَ مَعَهُ زَمَناً.
dialogue.tr: fadallahu ʿalā rajulin ṣāliḥin fī madīnati l-mawṣil, faraḥala ilayhi waʿāsha maʿahu zamanan.
dialogue.en: He pointed him to a good man in the city of Mosul, so Salman travelled to him and lived with him for a while.
dialogue.ur: Us ne unhein Mosul shehar ke ek nek aadmi ka pata bataya; Salman un ke paas gaye aur kuch arsa un ke saath rahe.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ تُوُفِّيَ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلُ، فَانْتَقَلَ إِلى عابِدٍ آخَرَ في نَصيبينَ، ثُمَّ إِلى عالِمٍ في عَمّورِيَّةَ.
dialogue.tr: thumma tuwuffiya dhālika r-rajul, fāntaqala ilā ʿābidin ʾākhara fī naṣībīn, thumma ilā ʿālimin fī ʿammūriyyata.
dialogue.en: Then that man died, so he moved to another worshipper in Nasibin, and then to a scholar in Ammuriyya.
dialogue.ur: Phir woh aadmi wafaat pa gaya to woh Nasibin ke ek aur abid ke paas, phir Ammuriyya ke ek aalim ke paas chale gaye.

dialogue.ar: وَفي عَمّورِيَّةَ عَمِلَ سَلْمانُ وَتَعَلَّمَ، حَتّى مَرِضَ شَيْخُهُ مَرَضَ المَوْتِ.
dialogue.tr: wafī ʿammūriyyata ʿamila salmānu wataʿallam, ḥattā mariḍa shaykhuhu maraḍa l-mawt.
dialogue.en: In Ammuriyya Salman worked and learned until his teacher fell fatally ill.
dialogue.ur: Ammuriyya mein Salman ne mehnat ki aur seekha, yahan tak ke un ke ustaad maut ki bimari mein mubtala hue.

dialogue.ar: فَقالَ الشَّيْخُ: لا أَعْرِفُ اليَوْمَ أَحَداً يَسيرُ عَلى طَريقِنا النَّقِيِّ.
dialogue.tr: faqāla sh-shaykh: lā aʿrifu l-yawma aḥadan yasīru ʿalā ṭarīqinā n-naqiyyi.
dialogue.en: The old man said: I know no one today who walks on our pure path.
dialogue.ur: Ustaad ne kaha: Aaj main kisi ko nahin jaanta jo hamare saaf suthre raaste par chal raha ho.

dialogue.ar: وَلَكِنَّ زَمَنَ نَبِيٍّ حَنيفٍ يُبْعَثُ في بِلادِ العَرَبِ قَدِ اقْتَرَبَ.
dialogue.tr: walakinna zamana nabiyyin ḥanīfin yubʿathu fī bilādi l-ʿarabi qadi qtarab.
dialogue.en: But the time of an upright prophet who will be sent in the land of the Arabs has come near.
dialogue.ur: Lekin ek haneef nabi ka zamana qareeb aa gaya hai jo Arab ki sarzameen mein bheja jayega.

dialogue.ar: وَسَيُهاجِرُ إِلى أَرْضٍ كَثيرَةِ النَّخْلِ بَيْنَ جَبَلَيْنِ مِنَ الحِجارَةِ السَّوْداءِ.
dialogue.tr: wasayuhājiru ilā arḍin kathīrati n-nakhli bayna jabalayni mina l-ḥijārati s-sawdāʾ.
dialogue.en: He will migrate to a land of many palm trees between two ranges of black stones.
dialogue.ur: Woh aisi zameen ki taraf hijrat karega jahan khajoor ke bohat darakht hain aur do kaale pathreele pahaadon ke darmiyan hai.

dialogue.ar: وَعَلاماتُهُ ثَلاثٌ: يَرُدُّ الصَّدَقَةَ وَلا يَأْكُلُها، وَيَقْبَلُ الهَدِيَّةَ، وَبَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ خاتَمُ النُّبُوَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: waʿalāmātuhu thalāthun: yaruddu ṣ-ṣadaqata walā yaʾkuluhā, wayaqbalu l-hadiyyata, wabayna katifayhi khātamu n-nubuwwati.
dialogue.en: His signs are three: he returns charity and does not eat it, he accepts gifts, and between his shoulders is the seal of prophethood.
dialogue.ur: Us ki teen nishaniyan hain: woh sadqa wapas kar deta hai aur nahin khata, tohfa qabool karta hai, aur us ke kandhon ke beech mohr-e-nubuwwat hai.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ مَرَّ رَكْبٌ مِنَ العَرَبِ، فَطَلَبَ مِنْهُمْ أَنْ يَحْمِلوهُ إِلى بِلادِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: thumma marra rakbun mina l-ʿarab, faṭalaba minhum an yaḥmilūhu ilā bilādihim.
dialogue.en: Then a caravan of Arabs passed by, and he asked them to take him to their country.
dialogue.ur: Phir Arabon ka ek qafila guzra to Salman ne un se kaha ke mujhe apne mulk le chalo.

dialogue.ar: لَكِنَّهُمْ غَدَروا بِهِ وَباعوهُ عَبْداً لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ يَهودَ، ثُمَّ انْتَقَلَ إِلى رَجُلٍ آخَرَ أَخَذَهُ إِلى المَدينَةِ.
dialogue.tr: lākinnahum ghadarū bihi wabāʿūhu ʿabdan lirajulin min yahūd, thumma ntaqala ilā rajulin ʾākhara akhadhahu ilā l-madīnati.
dialogue.en: But they betrayed him and sold him as a slave to a Jewish man, and then he passed to another man who took him to Medina.
dialogue.ur: Lekin unhon ne dhokha diya aur use ek yahoodi ke haath bech diya, phir woh ek aur aadmi ke paas gaye jo unhein Madina le gaya.

dialogue.ar: وَحينَ رَأى نَخْلَها عَرَفَ أَنَّها الأَرْضُ الَّتي وَصَفَها لَهُ شَيْخُهُ.
dialogue.tr: waḥīna raʾā nakhlahā ʿarafa annahā l-ʾarḍu allatī waṣafahā lahu shaykhuh.
dialogue.en: When he saw its palm trees, he knew it was the land his teacher had described to him.
dialogue.ur: Jab us ne wahan ke khajoor ke darakht dekhe to pehchan liya ke yeh wohi zameen hai jis ka zikr us ke ustaad ne kiya tha.

dialogue.ar: وَسَمِعَ أَنَّ رَسولَ اللهِ ﷺ نَزَلَ في قُباءَ، فَأَخَذَتْهُ رَعْشَةٌ مِنَ الفَرَحِ وَالخَوْفِ.
dialogue.tr: wasamiʿa anna rasūla Allāh ﷺ nazala fī qubāʾ, faʾakhadhathu raʿshatun mina l-faraḥi wa-l-khawf.
dialogue.en: He heard that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had stayed at Quba, and a shiver of joy and fear took hold of him.
dialogue.ur: Us ne suna ke Rasoolullah ﷺ Quba mein utre hain to khushi aur khauf se us par kapkapi taari ho gayi.

dialogue.ar: وَفي المَساءِ حَمَلَ شَيْئاً مِنَ الطَّعامِ وَقالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ: هَذِهِ صَدَقَةٌ لَكُمْ.
dialogue.tr: wafī l-masāʾi ḥamala shayʾan mina ṭ-ṭaʿāmi waqāla lilnnabiyyi ﷺ: hādhihi ṣadaqatun lakum.
dialogue.en: In the evening he carried some food and said to the Prophet ﷺ: This is charity for you.
dialogue.ur: Shaam ko woh kuch khana le kar aaye aur Nabi ﷺ se kaha: Yeh aap logon ke liye sadqa hai.

dialogue.ar: فَأَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَصْحابَهُ أَنْ يَأْكُلوا، وَامْتَنَعَ هُوَ عَنِ الأَكْلِ.
dialogue.tr: faʾamara n-nabiyyu ﷺ aṣḥābahu an yaʾkulū, wāmtanaʿa huwa ʿani l-ʾakl.
dialogue.en: The Prophet ﷺ told his companions to eat, while he himself held back from eating.
dialogue.ur: Nabi ﷺ ne apne sahaba ko khane ka hukm diya aur khud khane se ruk gaye.

dialogue.ar: وَفي اليَوْمِ التّالي جاءَ بِهَدِيَّةٍ، فَأَكَلَ مِنْها النَّبِيُّ ﷺ، فَعَرَفَ سَلْمانُ العَلامَةَ الثّانِيَةَ.
dialogue.tr: wafī l-yawmi t-tālī jāʾa bihadiyyatin, faʾakala minhā n-nabiyyu ﷺ, faʿarafa salmānu l-ʿalāmata th-thāniyata.
dialogue.en: The next day he came with a gift, the Prophet ﷺ ate from it, and Salman knew the second sign.
dialogue.ur: Agle din woh tohfa le kar aaye, Nabi ﷺ ne us mein se khaya aur Salman ne doosri nishani pehchan li.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ رَأى خاتَمَ النُّبُوَّةِ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ، فَبَكى وَأَسْلَمَ.
dialogue.tr: thumma raʾā khātama n-nubuwwati bayna katifayi n-nabiyyi ﷺ, fabakā waʾaslam.
dialogue.en: Then he saw the seal of prophethood between the Prophet's shoulders, wept and became a Muslim.
dialogue.ur: Phir unhon ne Nabi ﷺ ke kandhon ke beech mohr-e-nubuwwat dekhi, roye aur Islam qabool kar liya.

dialogue.ar: وَهَكَذا انْتَهَتْ رِحْلَةُ البَحْثِ الطَّويلَةُ، فَقَدْ أَقْبَلَ سَلْمانُ عَلى الإِسْلامِ، وَرَأى آياتِ الحَقِّ بِعَيْنَيْهِ.
dialogue.tr: wahakadhā ntahat riḥlatu l-baḥthi ṭ-ṭaūīlatu, faqad aqbala salmānu ʿalā l-ʾislām, waraʾā ʾāiyāti l-ḥaqqi biʿaynayh.
dialogue.en: So the long journey of searching ended: Salman turned to Islam and saw the signs of truth with his own eyes.
dialogue.ur: Yun talash ka lamba safar khatam hua: Salman Islam ki taraf aaye aur haq ki nishaniyan apni aankhon se dekhin.

title.en: Grammar (A): The style of praise and blame
title.ur: Qawaid (A): Madh aur Zamm ka uslub

intro.en: To praise something Arabic uses «نِعْمَ» (what an excellent...), and to blame it uses «بِئْسَ» (what an evil...). After the verb comes the thing described, then the one being praised or blamed. Example: نِعْمَ العادِلُ عُمَرُ – Umar is an excellent just man. «حَبَّذا» also praises, and «لا حَبَّذا» blames.
intro.ur: Kisi cheez ki tareef ke liye «نِعْمَ» (kya hi achha...) aur burai ke liye «بِئْسَ» (kya hi bura...) istemal hota hai. Is ke baad woh cheez aati hai jis ki baat ho rahi hai, phir jis ki tareef ya burai ki jaye. Misal: نِعْمَ العادِلُ عُمَرُ – Umar kya hi achhe adil hain. «حَبَّذا» bhi tareef ke liye hai aur «لا حَبَّذا» burai ke liye.
intro.ar: لِلْمَدْحِ نَسْتَعْمِلُ «نِعْمَ» وَلِلذَّمِّ نَسْتَعْمِلُ «بِئْسَ». يَأْتي بَعْدَ الفِعْلِ الفاعِلُ ثُمَّ المَمْدوحُ أَوِ المَذْمومُ، مِثْلُ: نِعْمَ العادِلُ عُمَرُ. وَ«حَبَّذا» لِلْمَدْحِ أَيْضاً، وَ«لا حَبَّذا» لِلذَّمِّ.

intro.en: Two listening parts. First, the story of at-Tufayl ibn Amr ad-Dawsi, a poet whose people were Dawsis. When he came to Makkah the Quraysh warned him about the Prophet ﷺ, so he stuffed his ears with cotton. Second, Arabic proverbs, where a man called Shann looks for clever answers. Listen to the audio on the slides and answer true or false.
intro.ur: Do sunne wale hisse hain. Pehla: at-Tufayl bin Amr ad-Dawsi ka qissa, jo ek shayar the. Jab woh Makkah aaye to Quraish ne unhein Nabi ﷺ se daraya, to unhon ne apne kaanon mein rui thoons li. Doosra: Arabi misalein, jahan Shann naam ka aadmi hoshiyari ke jawab dhoondta hai. Slides ki audio sunein aur sahi ya ghalat batayein.
intro.ar: في هذا الدَّرْسِ نَصّانِ لِلِاسْتِماعِ: الأَوَّلُ قِصَّةُ الطُّفَيْلِ بْنِ عَمْروٍ الدَّوْسِيِّ حينَ قَدِمَ مَكَّةَ وَسَدَّ أُذُنَيْهِ بِالقُطْنِ خَوْفاً مِنْ سَماعِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ، وَالثّاني أَمْثالٌ عَرَبِيَّةٌ. اسْتَمِعْ إِلى الصَّوْتِ وَأَجِبْ بِصَحيحٍ أَوْ خَطَأٍ.

intro.en: In this lesson you prepare a speech (khutba) on a topic you choose and practise delivering it to your classmates, without reading. You can write the main points, proofs and examples to prepare yourself. Tip: start with praise of Allah, state your topic clearly, give two or three examples, and finish with a short reminder.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein aap apni pasand ke mauzoo par taqreer (khutba) tayyar karte hain aur use sathiyon ke saamne bina parhe pesh karne ki mashq karte hain. Tayyari ke liye nukat, dalail aur misalein likh sakte hain. Mashwara: Allah ki hamd se shuru karein, mauzoo saaf bayan karein, do teen misalein dein aur chhoti si yaad-dehani par khatam karein.
intro.ar: في هذا الدَّرْسِ تَسْتَعِدُّ لِخُطْبَةٍ في مَوْضوعٍ تَخْتارُهُ، ثُمَّ تُلْقيها أَمامَ زُمَلائِكَ دونَ قِراءَةٍ. اكْتُبِ العَناصِرَ وَالأَدِلَّةَ وَالأَمْثِلَةَ لِتَسْتَعِدَّ. اِبْدَأْ بِحَمْدِ اللهِ، وَاذْكُرْ مَوْضوعَكَ بِوُضوحٍ، وَأَعْطِ مِثالَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاثَةً، ثُمَّ اخْتِمْ بِتَذْكيرٍ قَصيرٍ.

intro.en: The little word «ما» has many jobs. It can be a question word (what?), a relative word (that which: سَمِعْتُ ما قُلْتَهُ – I heard what you said), a negative (ما هذا بَشَراً – this is not a human), a word that makes a verb into a noun (أَعْجَبَني ما فَعَلْتَ – what you did pleased me), a word acting like «لَيْسَ», or a stopper (كافَّة) after «إِنَّ»: إِنَّما العِلْمُ نورٌ – knowledge is indeed light.
intro.ur: Chhota sa lafz «ما» kai kaam karta hai. Yeh sawal ka lafz ho sakta hai (kya?), mausool (jo kuch: سَمِعْتُ ما قُلْتَهُ – maine suna jo tum ne kaha), nafi ka (ما هذا بَشَراً – yeh insaan nahin), fel ko masdar bana dene wala (أَعْجَبَني ما فَعَلْتَ – tumhara kaam mujhe pasand aaya), «لَيْسَ» ki tarah amal karne wala, ya «إِنَّ» ke baad rukawat dalne wala (كافَّة): إِنَّما العِلْمُ نورٌ – ilm to roshni hi hai.
intro.ar: لِكَلِمَةِ «ما» اسْتِعْمالاتٌ كَثيرَةٌ: فَقَدْ تَكونُ اسْتِفْهامِيَّةً، أَوْ مَوْصولَةً مِثْلَ: سَمِعْتُ ما قُلْتَهُ، أَوْ نافِيَةً مِثْلَ: ما هذا بَشَراً، أَوْ مَصْدَرِيَّةً مِثْلَ: أَعْجَبَني ما فَعَلْتَ، أَوْ تَعْمَلُ عَمَلَ «لَيْسَ»، أَوْ كافَّةً بَعْدَ «إِنَّ» مِثْلَ: إِنَّما العِلْمُ نورٌ.

dialogue.ar: خُذْ ما يَنْفَعُكَ وَاتْرُكْ ما يَضُرُّكَ.
dialogue.tr: khudh mā yanfaʿuka wātruk mā yaḍurruk.
dialogue.en: Take what benefits you and leave what harms you. («ما» = that which, relative)
dialogue.ur: Woh lo jo tumhein faida de aur woh chhor do jo nuqsan de. («ما» = jo, mausool)

dialogue.ar: قَرَأْتُ ما كَتَبَهُ الأُسْتاذُ عَلى السَّبّورَةِ.
dialogue.tr: qaraʾtu mā katabahu l-ʾustādhu ʿalā s-sabbūrati.
dialogue.en: I read what the teacher wrote on the board.
dialogue.ur: Maine woh parha jo ustaad ne takhte par likha.

dialogue.ar: ما في الخَزّانِ مِنْ ماءٍ يَنْفَدُ سَريعاً.
dialogue.tr: mā fī l-khazzāni min māʾin yanfadu sarīʿan.
dialogue.en: The water in the tank runs out quickly.
dialogue.ur: Tanki mein jo pani hai woh jaldi khatam ho jata hai.

dialogue.ar: أَعْجَبَني ما بَذَلَهُ الطُّلّابُ مِنْ جُهْدٍ.
dialogue.tr: aʿjabanī mā badhalahu ṭ-ṭullābu min juhdin.
dialogue.en: The effort the students made pleased me. («ما» + verb = a noun meaning)
dialogue.ur: Talba ne jo koshish ki woh mujhe pasand aayi. («ما» + fel = masdar ke maani)

dialogue.ar: ما هَذِهِ الرّائِحَةُ الجَميلَةُ؟
dialogue.tr: mā hādhihi r-rāʾiḥatu l-jamīlatu?
dialogue.en: What is this lovely smell? («ما» = what? a question word)
dialogue.ur: Yeh pyari khushboo kya hai? («ما» = kya? sawaliya)

dialogue.ar: ما تَزْرَعْ تَحْصُدْ.
dialogue.tr: mā tazraʿ taḥṣud.
dialogue.en: Whatever you sow, you reap. («ما» = whatever, a conditional word)
dialogue.ur: Jo boo gay wohi kaato gay. («ما» = jo bhi, sharti)

dialogue.ar: ما الكَسولُ ناجِحاً في دُروسِهِ.
dialogue.tr: mā l-kasūlu nājiḥan fī durūsih.
dialogue.en: The lazy one is not successful in his lessons. («ما» acts like «لَيْسَ»)
dialogue.ur: Susst talib-e-ilm apne sabaq mein kamyab nahin. («ما» «لَيْسَ» ki tarah)

dialogue.ar: ما الكَرَمُ مَكْروهاً بَيْنَ النّاسِ.
dialogue.tr: mā l-karamu makrūhan bayna n-nās.
dialogue.en: Generosity is not disliked among people.
dialogue.ur: Sakhawat logon mein napasandeeda nahin hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّما المَعْروفُ يَبْقى أَثَرُهُ.
dialogue.tr: innamā l-maʿrūfu yabqā atharuh.
dialogue.en: Kindness indeed leaves a lasting trace. («ما» stops «إِنَّ» from working)
dialogue.ur: Neki ka asar baqi rehta hai. («ما» «إِنَّ» ka amal rok deta hai)

dialogue.ar: كَأَنَّما القَمَرُ مِصْباحٌ في السَّماءِ.
dialogue.tr: kaʾannamā l-qamaru miṣbāḥun fī s-samāʾ.
dialogue.en: As if the moon were a lamp in the sky.
dialogue.ur: Goya chand aasman mein ek chiragh hai.

title.en: Extended reading: The rights of neighbours

intro.en: A story about a wise village judge who sits with the people every Thursday. A newcomer complains that his neighbours never visited him, and a farmer complains about an unpaid loan. As you read, notice the judge's calm questions and what he teaches about the rights of neighbours.
intro.ur: Ek daana gaon ke qazi ki kahani jo har jumeraat logon ke liye baithte hain. Ek naya aane wala shikayat karta hai ke padosiyon ne kabhi us ki ayadat nahin ki, aur ek kisan ek wapas na hone wale qarz ki shikayat karta hai. Parhte waqt qazi ke pur-sukoon sawalat par ghaur karein aur dekhein ke woh padosiyon ke huqooq ke bare mein kya sikhate hain.
intro.ar: قِصَّةٌ عَنْ قاضٍ حَكيمٍ في قَرْيَةٍ يَجْلِسُ لِلنّاسِ كُلَّ خَميسٍ. يَشْكو رَجُلٌ جَديدٌ أَنَّ جيرانَهُ لَمْ يَزورُوهُ قَطُّ، وَيَشْكو فَلّاحٌ دَيْناً لَمْ يُرَدَّ. لاحِظْ أَسْئِلَةَ القاضي الهادِئَةَ وَما يُعَلِّمُهُ النّاسَ عَنْ حُقوقِ الجيرانِ.

dialogue.ar: كانَ في قَرْيَةٍ عِنْدَ سَفْحِ الجَبَلِ قاضٍ حَكيمٌ اسْمُهُ مُنْذِرٌ، يَجْلِسُ لِلنّاسِ كُلَّ خَميسٍ في ساحَةِ القَرْيَةِ.
dialogue.tr: kāna fī qaryatin ʿinda safḥi l-jabali qāḍin ḥakīmun smuhu mundhirun, yajlisu lilnnāsi kulla khamīsin fī sāḥati l-qaryati.
dialogue.en: In a village at the foot of the mountain there was a wise judge named Mundhir, who sat with the people every Thursday in the village square.
dialogue.ur: Pahaad ke daaman mein ek gaon tha jahan Mundhir naam ke ek daana qazi har jumeraat gaon ke maidan mein logon ke liye baithte the.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ أَهْلُ القَرْيَةِ يُحَكِّمونَهُ في كُلِّ مَظْلَمَةٍ تَقَعُ بَيْنَ الجيرانِ، لِأَنَّهُمْ يَعْرِفونَ أَنَّهُ يُنْصِفُ المَظْلومَ وَلا يَخافُ أَحَداً.
dialogue.tr: wakāna ahlu l-qaryati yuḥakkimūnahu fī kulli maẓlamatin taqaʿu bayna l-jīrān, liʾannahum yaʿrifūna annahu yunṣifu l-maẓlūma walā yakhāfu aḥadan.
dialogue.en: The villagers made him judge in every complaint between neighbours, because they knew he gave the wronged person justice and feared no one.
dialogue.ur: Gaon wale padosiyon ke har jhagde mein unhein faisla karne dete, kyunke woh jaante the ke woh mazloom ko insaf dete hain aur kisi se nahin darte.

dialogue.ar: وَذاتَ خَميسٍ جاءَ رَجُلٌ غَريبٌ اسْمُهُ سالِمٌ، سَكَنَ القَرْيَةَ قَبْلَ شَهْرَيْنِ، وَعَلى وَجْهِهِ عَلاماتُ الحُزْنِ.
dialogue.tr: wadhāta khamīsin jāʾa rajulun gharībun smuhu sālimun, sakana l-qaryata qabla shahrayn, waʿalā wajhihi ʿalāmātu l-ḥuzn.
dialogue.en: One Thursday a stranger named Salim came, who had settled in the village two months earlier, with signs of sadness on his face.
dialogue.ur: Ek jumeraat ko Salim naam ka ek ajnabi aaya, jo do mahine pehle gaon mein basa tha, aur us ke chehre par udaasi ke nishan the.

dialogue.ar: تَفَضَّلْ يا سالِمُ، ما شَكْواكَ؟ وَمَنِ الَّذي ظَلَمَكَ؟
dialogue.tr: tafaḍḍal yā sālim, mā shakwāk? wamani alladhī ẓalamak?
dialogue.en: Please, Salim, what is your complaint? And who wronged you?
dialogue.ur: Tashreef rakhiye Salim, aap ki shikayat kya hai? Aur kis ne aap par zulm kiya?

dialogue.ar: لَمْ يَظْلِمْني أَحَدٌ يا سَيِّدي القاضِي، وَلَكِنَّني أَشْكو مِنْ جيرانِي كُلِّهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: lam yaẓlimnī aḥadun yā sayyidī l-qāḍī, walakinnanī ashkū min jīrānī kullihim.
dialogue.en: No one wronged me, my lord the judge, but I complain about all my neighbours.
dialogue.ur: Mujh par kisi ne zulm nahin kiya janab qazi sahab, magar mujhe apne sab padosiyon se shikayat hai.

dialogue.ar: فَدُهِشَ القاضِي، فَقَدْ كانَ يَظُنُّ أَنَّ أَهْلَ قَرْيَتِهِ لا يُؤْذونَ أَحَداً.
dialogue.tr: faduhisha l-qāḍī, faqad kāna yaẓunnu anna ahla qaryatihi lā yuʾdhūna aḥadan.
dialogue.en: The judge was astonished, for he had thought the people of his village harmed no one.
dialogue.ur: Qazi hairan reh gaye, kyunke woh samajhte the ke un ke gaon ke log kisi ko takleef nahin dete.

dialogue.ar: كُلِّهِمْ؟ وَماذا فَعَلوا بِكَ؟ اُذْكُرْ ما عِنْدَكَ بِهُدوءٍ.
dialogue.tr: kullihim? wa mādhā faʿalū bik? udhkur mā ʿindaka bihudūʾin.
dialogue.en: All of them? And what did they do to you? Tell me what you have, calmly.
dialogue.ur: Sab ki? Aur unhon ne aap ke saath kya kiya? Jo kuch hai sukoon se bayan kijiye.

dialogue.ar: مَرِضْتُ الشَّهْرَ الماضِيَ عَشَرَةَ أَيّامٍ، وَلَمْ يَطْرُقْ بابِي أَحَدٌ لِلزِّيارَةِ.
dialogue.tr: mariḍtu sh-shahra l-māḍiya ʿasharata ayyāmin, walam yaṭruq bābī aḥadun lilzziyārati.
dialogue.en: I was ill last month for ten days, and no one knocked at my door to visit.
dialogue.ur: Pichle mahine main das din bimar raha aur koi meri ayadat ke liye mere darwaze par nahin aaya.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ تُوُفِّيَ أَخي الصَّغيرُ، فَلَمْ يَأْتِ أَحَدٌ لِيُعَزِّيَني، وَلَمْ يَمْشِ مَعَنا إِلى المَقْبَرَةِ إِلاّ اثْنانِ، وَهَذا نَغَّصَ عَلَيَّ عَيْشي.
dialogue.tr: thumma tuwuffiya akhī ṣ-ṣaghīr, falam yaʾti aḥadun liyuʿazziyanī, walam yamshi maʿanā ilā l-maqbarati ilā thnān, wahadhā naghghaṣa ʿalayya ʿayshī.
dialogue.en: Then my little brother died, and no one came to console me, and only two walked with us to the graveyard. This has spoiled my life for me.
dialogue.ur: Phir mera chhota bhai wafaat pa gaya, koi taziyat ko nahin aaya aur sirf do log hamare saath qabristan gaye. Isi ne meri zindagi ka maza kirkira kar diya.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَعْرِفُ جيرانَكَ بِأَسْمائِهِمْ يا سالِمُ؟ وَهَلْ سَلَّمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ؟
dialogue.tr: hal taʿrifu jīrānaka biʾasmāʾihim yā sālim? wahal sallamta ʿalayhim?
dialogue.en: Do you know your neighbours by name, Salim? And have you greeted them?
dialogue.ur: Salim, kya aap apne padosiyon ko naam se jaante hain? Aur kya aap ne unhein salam kiya?

dialogue.ar: صَدَقْتَ يا سَيِّدي، لَمْ أُسَلِّمْ عَلى أَحَدٍ؛ فَقَدْ كُنْتُ أَخْجَلُ، وَأَظُنُّ أَنَّهُمْ لا يُحِبّونَ الغُرَباءَ.
dialogue.tr: ṣadaqta yā sayyidī, lam usallim ʿalā aḥadin; faqad kuntu akhjal, waʾaẓunnu annahum lā yuḥibbūna l-ghurabāʾ.
dialogue.en: You are right, my lord, I greeted no one; I felt shy and thought they did not like strangers.
dialogue.ur: Aap ne sach kaha janab, maine kisi ko salam nahin kiya; mujhe sharm aati thi aur main samajhta tha ke woh ajnabiyon ko pasand nahin karte.

dialogue.ar: فَأَمَرَ القاضِي أَنْ يُدْعى جيرانُ سالِمٍ، فَحَضَرَ مِنْهُمْ جَماعَةٌ، وَمِنْهُمْ حامِدٌ وَجَمالٌ وَأُمُّ خالِدٍ.
dialogue.tr: faʾamara l-qāḍī an yudʿā jīrānu sālimin, faḥaḍara minhum jamāʿatun, waminhum ḥāmidun wajamālun waʾummu khālidin.
dialogue.en: The judge ordered Salim's neighbours to be called, and a group of them came, among them Hamid, Jamal and Umm Khalid.
dialogue.ur: Qazi ne hukm diya ke Salim ke padosiyon ko bulaya jaye; un mein se ek jamaat aayi, jin mein Hamid, Jamal aur Umm Khalid bhi thin.

dialogue.ar: يَقولُ جارُكُمْ سالِمٌ إِنَّكُمْ لَمْ تَزورُوهُ في مَرَضِهِ وَلَمْ تُعَزّوهُ في مُصيبَتِهِ. فَما جَوابُكُمْ؟
dialogue.tr: yaqūlu jārukum sālimun innakum lam tazūrūhu fī maraḍihi walam tuʿazzūhu fī muṣībatih. famā jawābukum?
dialogue.en: Your neighbour Salim says you did not visit him in his illness and did not console him in his loss. What is your answer?
dialogue.ur: Aap ka padosi Salim kehta hai ke aap ne us ki bimari mein ayadat nahin ki aur us ki museebat mein taziyat nahin ki. Aap ka kya jawab hai?

dialogue.ar: وَاللهِ يا سَيِّدي ما عَلِمْنا بِمَرَضِهِ! بابُهُ مُغْلَقٌ دائِماً، وَلا نَراهُ إِلاّ عِنْدَ الفَجْرِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-l-lhi yā sayyidī mā ʿalimnā bimaraḍih! bābuhu mughlaqun dāʾiman, walā narāhu ilā ʿinda l-fajr.
dialogue.en: By Allah, my lord, we did not know about his illness! His door is always closed, and we see him only at dawn.
dialogue.ur: Allah ki qasam janab, hamein us ki bimari ka ilm nahin tha! Us ka darwaza hamesha band rehta hai aur hum use sirf fajr ke waqt dekhte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَنَحْنُ ظَنَنّا أَنَّهُ يُحِبُّ العُزْلَةَ، فَلَمْ نُرِدْ أَنْ نُزْعِجَهُ.
dialogue.tr: wanaḥnu ẓanannā annahu yuḥibbu l-ʿuzlata, falam nurid an nuzʿijah.
dialogue.en: And we thought he liked to be alone, so we did not want to disturb him.
dialogue.ur: Aur hum ne samjha ke use tanhai pasand hai, is liye hum use pareshan nahin karna chahte the.

dialogue.ar: الجارُ يا إِخْوَتي لا يَنْتَظِرُ دَعْوَةً. إِذا غابَ جارُكَ أَيّاماً فَاسْأَلْ عَنْهُ وَاطْرُقْ بابَهُ.
dialogue.tr: al-jāru yā ikhwatī lā yantaẓiru daʿwatan. idhā ghāba jāruka ayyāman fāsʾal ʿanhu wāṭruq bābah.
dialogue.en: A neighbour, my brothers, does not wait for an invitation. If your neighbour is absent for days, ask about him and knock at his door.
dialogue.ur: Bhaiyo, padosi dawat ka intezar nahin karta. Agar aap ka padosi kai din nazar na aaye to us ka haal poochiye aur us ka darwaza khatkhataiye.

dialogue.ar: فَنَظَرَ الجيرانُ إِلى الأَرْضِ، وَقَدْ شَعَروا بِالخَجَلِ. ثُمَّ قالَ حامِدٌ:
dialogue.tr: fanaẓara l-jīrānu ilā l-ʾarḍ, waqad shaʿarū bi-l-khajal. thumma qāla ḥāmidun:
dialogue.en: The neighbours looked at the ground, feeling ashamed. Then Hamid said:
dialogue.ur: Padosi zameen ki taraf dekhne lage, un par sharmindagi chha gayi. Phir Hamid ne kaha:

dialogue.ar: يا سَيِّدي القاضِي، إِنَّ لي شَكْوى أَيْضاً، وَهِيَ عَلى جارِي جَمالٍ.
dialogue.tr: yā sayyidī l-qāḍī, inna lī shakwā ayḍan, wahiya ʿalā jārī jamālin.
dialogue.en: My lord the judge, I also have a complaint, and it is against my neighbour Jamal.
dialogue.ur: Janab qazi sahab, meri bhi ek shikayat hai aur woh mere padosi Jamal ke bare mein hai.

dialogue.ar: تَكَلَّمْ يا حامِدُ.
dialogue.tr: takallam yā ḥāmid.
dialogue.en: Speak, Hamid.
dialogue.ur: Boliye Hamid.

dialogue.ar: أَقْرَضْتُ جَمالاً كيساً مِنَ القَمْحِ في الشِّتاءِ الماضِي، وَمَضَتْ سَنَةٌ كامِلَةٌ وَلَمْ يَرُدَّ لي شَيْئاً.
dialogue.tr: aqraḍtu jamālan kīsan mina l-qamḥi fī sh-shitāʾi l-māḍī, wamaḍat sanatun kāmilatun walam yarudda lī shayʾan.
dialogue.en: I lent Jamal a sack of wheat last winter, and a whole year has passed and he has returned nothing to me.
dialogue.ur: Maine pichli sardiyon mein Jamal ko gandum ka ek bora qarz diya, ab poora saal guzar gaya aur us ne kuch wapas nahin kiya.

dialogue.ar: يا جَمالُ، هَلِ اقْتَرَضْتَ مِنْهُ ذَلِكَ الكيسَ؟
dialogue.tr: yā jamāl, hali qtaraḍta minhu dhālika l-kīs?
dialogue.en: Jamal, did you borrow that sack from him?
dialogue.ur: Jamal, kya aap ne us se woh bora qarz liya tha?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ يا سَيِّدي، اقْتَرَضْتُهُ حينَ أَهْلَكَ الجَفافُ زَرْعي، وَما زِلْتُ أَعيشُ في فَقْرٍ، وَقَدْ تَوالَتْ عَلَيَّ المَصائِبُ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam yā sayyidī, qtaraḍtuhu ḥīna ahlaka l-jafāfu zarʿī, wamā ziltu aʿīshu fī faqrin, waqad tawālat ʿalayya l-maṣāʾib.
dialogue.en: Yes, my lord, I borrowed it when drought ruined my crops, and I still live in poverty, and misfortunes have followed one after another.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan janab, maine woh us waqt liya jab qahat ne meri fasal tabah kar di, main ab bhi ghurbat mein hoon aur mujh par musibaten ek ke baad ek aayi hain.

dialogue.ar: لَيْسَ في نِيَّتي أَنْ آكُلَ حَقَّ جارِي، وَلَكِنَّني أَخْجَلُ أَنْ أَطْرُقَ بابَهُ وَيَدي فارِغَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: laysa fī niyyatī an ʾākula ḥaqqa jārī, walakinnanī akhjalu an aṭruqa bābahu wayadī fārighatun.
dialogue.en: I have no intention of eating my neighbour's right, but I am ashamed to knock at his door with empty hands.
dialogue.ur: Mera irada apne padosi ka haq khane ka nahin, magar mujhe sharm aati hai ke khaali haath us ka darwaza khatkhataun.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنْتَ يا حامِدُ، هَلْ سَأَلْتَهُ يَوْماً عَنْ حالِهِ؟ هَلْ زُرْتَهُ؟
dialogue.tr: waʾanta yā ḥāmid, hal saʾaltahu yawman ʿan ḥālih? hal zurtah?
dialogue.en: And you, Hamid, did you ever ask him how he was? Did you visit him?
dialogue.ur: Aur aap Hamid, kya aap ne kabhi us ka haal poocha? Kya us se milne gaye?

dialogue.ar: لا يا سَيِّدي، كُنْتُ أَنْتَظِرُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ هُوَ وَيَرُدَّ دَيْنَهُ.
dialogue.tr: lā yā sayyidī, kuntu antaẓiru an yaʾtiya huwa wayarudda daynah.
dialogue.en: No, my lord, I was waiting for him to come and repay his debt.
dialogue.ur: Nahin janab, main intezar kar raha tha ke woh khud aaye aur apna qarz utare.

dialogue.ar: حَقُّكَ مَحْفوظٌ يا حامِدُ، وَالإِحْسانُ إِلى الفَقيرِ أَجْمَلُ مِنَ العِتابِ. وَأَنْتَ يا جَمالُ، رُدَّ ما اقْتَرَضْتَ عِنْدَما تَقْدِرُ، وَلا تَخْجَلْ مِنْ مُصارَحَةِ جارِكَ.
dialogue.tr: ḥaqquka maḥfūẓun yā ḥāmid, wa-l-ʾiḥsānu ilā l-faqīri ajmalu mina l-ʿitāb. waʾanta yā jamāl, rudda mā qtaraḍta ʿindamā taqdir, walā takhjal min muṣāraḥati jārik.
dialogue.en: Your right is safe, Hamid, and kindness to the poor is more beautiful than blame. And you, Jamal, give back what you borrowed when you are able, and do not be ashamed to be frank with your neighbour.
dialogue.ur: Hamid, aap ka haq mehfooz hai, aur gareeb ke saath ehsan karna shikwe se behtar hai. Aur Jamal, jab ba-istitaat ho to jo liya wapas karo aur apne padosi se saaf baat karne mein sharm na karo.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ وَقَفَ القاضِي وَخاطَبَ الحاضِرينَ جَميعاً، فَقالَ:
dialogue.tr: thumma waqafa l-qāḍī wakhāṭaba l-ḥāḍirīna jamīʿan, faqāl:
dialogue.en: Then the judge stood up and addressed everyone present, saying:
dialogue.ur: Phir qazi khade hue aur tamam hazireen se mukhatib hokar bole:

dialogue.ar: لِلْجارِ عَلى جارِهِ حُقوقٌ وَواجِباتٌ؛ فَلا يُؤْذيهِ بِكَلِمَةٍ، وَلا يَبْني ما يَحْجُبُ عَنْهُ الشَّمْسَ وَالهَواءَ.
dialogue.tr: liljāri ʿalā jārihi ḥuqūqun wawājibātun; falā yuʾdhīhi bikalimatin, walā yabnī mā yaḥjubu ʿanhu sh-shamsa wa-l-hawāʾ.
dialogue.en: A neighbour has rights and duties towards his neighbour; so he does not hurt him with a word, nor build what blocks the sun and air from him.
dialogue.ur: Padosi ke padosi par huqooq aur farayz hain; woh use ek lafz se bhi takleef na de aur aisi taameer na kare jo us se dhoop aur hawa rok de.

dialogue.ar: وَإِذا طَبَخَ طَعاماً فَفاحَتْ رائِحَتُهُ، فَلْيُرْسِلْ إِلى جيرانِهِ مِنْهُ شَيْئاً، وَلا يَنْسَ أَنَّ بَيْنَهُمْ مُحْتاجاً.
dialogue.tr: waʾidhā ṭabakha ṭaʿāman fafāḥat rāʾiḥatuh, falyursil ilā jīrānihi minhu shayʾan, walā yansa anna baynahum muḥtājan.
dialogue.en: And if he cooks food and its smell spreads, let him send his neighbours some of it, and not forget that there may be a needy person among them.
dialogue.ur: Aur jab woh khana pakaye aur us ki khushboo phail jaye to apne padosiyon ko us mein se kuch bheje aur yaad rakhe ke un mein koi zaroorat-mand ho sakta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَتَذَكَّروا قَوْلَ نَبِيِّنا ﷺ:
dialogue.tr: watadhakkarū qawla nabiyyinā ﷺ:
dialogue.en: And remember the saying of our Prophet ﷺ:
dialogue.ur: Aur apne Nabi ﷺ ka farman yaad rakho:

dialogue.ar: مَا زَالَ جِبْرِيلُ يُوصِينِي بِالْجَارِ حَتَّى ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ سَيُوَرِّثُهُ.
dialogue.tr: mā zāla jibrīlu yūṣīnī bi-l-jāri ḥattaā ẓanantu annahu sayuwarrithuh.
dialogue.en: Jibril kept advising me about the neighbour until I thought he would make him an heir.
dialogue.ur: Jibreel mujhe padosi ke bare mein baar baar wasiyat karte rahe, yahan tak ke mujhe gumaan hua ke woh use waris bana denge.

dialogue.ar: فَسَكَتَ الجَميعُ، وَسالَتِ الدُّموعُ مِنْ عَيْنَيْ سالِمٍ، وَقَدْ شَعَرَ أَنَّ لَهُ في هَذِهِ القَرْيَةِ أَهْلاً.
dialogue.tr: fasakata l-jamīʿ, wasālati d-dumūʿu min ʿaynay sālimin, waqad shaʿara anna lahu fī hādhihi l-qaryati ahlan.
dialogue.en: Everyone was silent, tears flowed from Salim's eyes, and he felt that he had family in this village.
dialogue.ur: Sab khamosh ho gaye, Salim ki aankhon se aansu beh nikle aur unhein laga ke is gaon mein un ke apne maujood hain.

dialogue.ar: سامِحْنا يا سالِمُ، سَنَزورُكَ غَداً بَعْدَ العَصْرِ إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ.
dialogue.tr: sāmiḥnā yā sālim, sanazūruka ghadan baʿda l-ʿaṣri in shāʾa Allā.
dialogue.en: Forgive us, Salim, we will visit you tomorrow after Asr, if Allah wills.
dialogue.ur: Humein maaf kar do Salim, hum kal asr ke baad insha-Allah tumhari ayadat ko aayenge.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا سَأُرْسِلُ إِلَيْكَ طَبَقاً مِنَ الطَّعامِ السّاخِنِ اللَّيْلَةَ.
dialogue.tr: waʾanā saʾursilu ilayka ṭabaqan mina ṭ-ṭaʿāmi s-sākhini l-laylata.
dialogue.en: And I will send you a plate of hot food tonight.
dialogue.ur: Aur main aaj raat aap ke liye garam khane ka ek thaal bhejungi.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ لِأَنَّني ظَنَنْتُ بِكُمْ سُوءاً، وَسَأَكونُ أَوَّلَ مَنْ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنَ الآنَ.
dialogue.tr: waʾanā astaghfiru Allāh liʾannanī ẓanantu bikum sūʾan, wasaʾakūnu awwala man yusallimu ʿalaykum mina l-ʾān.
dialogue.en: And I ask Allah's forgiveness for thinking badly of you, and from now on I will be the first to greet you.
dialogue.ur: Aur main Allah se maafi maangta hoon ke maine aap logon ke bare mein bura gumaan kiya, ab se main sab se pehle salam karunga.

dialogue.ar: هَكَذا تَدُلُّنا الشَّريعَةُ عَلى بِناءِ المُجْتَمَعِ: قُلوبٌ مُتَقارِبَةٌ، وَأَيْدٍ مُتَعاوِنَةٌ، وَأَبْوابٌ مَفْتوحَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: hakadhā tadullunā sh-sharīʿatu ʿalā bināʾi l-mujtamaʿ: qulūbun mutaqāribatun, waʾaydin mutaʿāwinatun, waʾabwābun maftūḥatun.
dialogue.en: This is how the Shariah guides us in building a community: close hearts, cooperating hands and open doors.
dialogue.ur: Shariat humein samaj banane ka tareeqa yun sikhati hai: qareeb dil, ek doosre ka saath dene wale haath aur khule darwaze.

dialogue.ar: وَمُنْذُ ذَلِكَ اليَوْمِ صارَ أَهْلُ القَرْيَةِ يَتَفَقَّدونَ جيرانَهُمْ، وَصارَتِ الأَبْوابُ تُطْرَقُ لِلسَّلامِ لا لِلشَّكْوى.
dialogue.tr: wamundhu dhālika l-yawmi ṣāra ahlu l-qaryati yatafaqqadūna jīrānahum, waṣārati l-ʾabwābu tuṭraqu lilssalāmi lā lilshshakwā.
dialogue.en: From that day the villagers began to look after their neighbours, and doors were knocked at to greet, not to complain.
dialogue.ur: Us din ke baad gaon wale apne padosiyon ki khabar rakhne lage aur darwaze shikayat ke liye nahin, salam ke liye khatkhataye jane lage.
